subject.size_in_frame: tighter than sh069 — mouth and jaw about 0.34 of frame height, the crop closing in without moving the axis

headroom: none, and less of it than sh069: the tightening is the only change between the two frames, and it is what makes the order and the failure to obey it land in three and a half seconds.
horizon_eyeline: Same set-up, tighter. Flagstone line pushed to 0.92 of frame height. Still no eyes in frame.

layers.fg: her knee, now nearly abstract, a field of blue cotton weave

gaze.note: unchanged from sh069 — she is still talking downward at herself, and the composition still gives her nobody.

balance: The sh069 balance compressed. Less air, more cotton, same single lit mouth.
leading_lines: The jaw line and the knee line, closer together than before — the frame is squeezing.
eye_first: The mouth, immediately; there is nothing else in frame.
constraint_binding: Held just long enough for the order and the failure to obey it — the comedy and the distress are the same shot, so there is no reframe between the two and no second angle to separate them.
